<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 121.0528 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral mass of approximately 120.0455 Da. The formula C₈H₈O has a calculated exact mass of 120.0575 Da, which is the closest simple composition to this value and fits the expected elemental set (C, H, O). Therefore, the molecular formula is C₈H₈O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H8O</final_answer>
